Kd.bar_b_note: Murky near-black forest floor with no purple storm sky or lightning, flat magenta ground telegraphs, a tiny unreadable player creature and HUD panels filling a third of the frame sink it; only the gold-lit Voltarach silhouette carries.

Po.bar_b_note: Creatures and the stockade read clearly, but the muddy ochre-olive grade, flat grass and flat lilac slab/gold ring decals instead of physical impacts keep it short of Palworld's saturated, punchy hits.

Lb.bar_b_note: Readable two-creature staging, but the hedgehog holds one pose through every hit (a STAGGER label instead of a stagger) and the olive-brown grade has no Valheim-class atmosphere.

Oz.bar_b_note: B's rearing badger at f23 is the first body reaction in the batch, but big translucent lilac slabs and a dim olive grade still read as prototype rather than shipped finish.

Px.bar_b_note: For f01-f13 the camera frames only the hedgehog and trainer on flat dark grass with the enemy off screen, so there is no readable fight and no atmosphere.

Sb.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing grandfather villager with clear face and eyes and a natural olive/cream palette that sits comfortably beside Palworld's humans, held back only by being a touch more cartoon than the naturalistic creatures.

Qi.bar_b_note: Good scale and a strong plated-boar silhouette, but very dark low-value materials that go almost black at faint end (A) or an off-board red lava glow with red tusks (B) fall short of the owner's rim-lit naturalistic bar.

Tm.bar_b_note: The blue-grey translucent panel fits the UI direction, but salmon cost text, no teal/gold accents and (in B) tiny clipped text and a faint 'Craft: A / Enter' line read as an unfinished menu over a dim, bare world.

top_changes.change: Add authored hit-react, flinch, stagger and lean poses (with additive layering during movement) for every creature so hits and dodges change the body silhouette instead of only spawning ring decals and labels

Fix combat framing: keep both fighters in frame (Px), push the camera out of trunks and canopy (Kd A), shrink and edge-anchor the Kd HUD, and replace flat magenta/lilac telegraph slabs and gold ring decals with grounded physical effects (dust, stone, lightning) that land on the target

Regrade and relight: lift Meadows from muddy ochre-olive to warm green with cool blue distance, give Stormwood its purple sky, white-violet lightning and rim light, and lift creature material values (no near-black faint states, no off-board red emissive)
